record.body:
## Problem

The raw markdown frame is hard to read. It has no counts, no progress, and no color.

## Approach

A Textual app in se-workflow reads the store through `adaptive-artifacts list` JSON. It shows a header with the effort and phase progress, count tiles, a color-coded task table, and recent activity. It stays read-only.

## Exit criteria

Decide at plan-phase.
record.subject: readable-layout
